authority: Root explicitly identified these completed summaries; no raw/current family artifacts reopened. Numeric contents of original summary were visible but no scores recomputed or used to choose strength.
qualitative_findings: Ordinary shared members are not universally weaker; capable shared states can still have greater common-negative burden and worse Hits10.
Lower common overlap in live transfer coincided with weaker members and a larger error union.
Graph-conditioned initialization improved mean member MRR relative to several copied controls, but its final pool lost all three paired comparisons to the stated normal/sign/copied-bank controls.
Copied independent warm bank is not independently acquired native ensemble; selector/acquisition differences preclude causal sharing diagnosis.
citeseer_source_interpretation_excerpt: The primary graph covariance initialization does not show a consistent aggregate MRR advantage over the fixed controls on these three source-selected VALID banks.

Copied independent warm four has lower mean member MRR 0.259492 but larger pooling gain 0.023042 and fewer all-member/common-slot errors. It shares one warm donor and a pooled selector and pays four full member trajectories; it is not four independently acquired donors or evidence that the graph initialization is necessary.

Graph repairs some baseline common errors, while regressions and reciprocal-rank losses elsewhere prevent an aggregate gain. Baseline common-error cohorts alone are conditional diagnostics, not a stand-alone success criterion.
Feature covariance uses graph-derived H and is not a graph-free control. These are initialization arms; no growth capacity/necessity inference is established by this initialization-only read.

Three optimizer seeds on one fixed graph/split give conditional optimizer-seed dispersion only. VALID selector optimism remains after twelve exposures, first strict rounded4 maximum, and no reselection. Queries are not iid graph replications; no graph-population CI or significance claim is made.
historical_context_limits: Common-error cohort repairs must be balanced against introduced full-population errors
